content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 14.10 Assignment, p0188) — submitted.**

- **Issue:** The assignment restriction is one-sided. Only Customer needs consent; IBM may freely assign (§§ 14.2 and 14.18 already contemplate IBM assignees), potentially to a competitor of ours. The existing M&A carve-out omits assignment to our affiliates and a sale of all or substantially all assets.
- **Change-of-control:** No change-of-control provision exists in the Agreement, and § 3.3 is a standard mutual termination-for-cause clause with no linked trigger, so nothing to delete there.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** made the consent restriction mutual, added a consent-free carve-out for assignment to our affiliates or a successor by merger/consolidation/acquisition/asset sale, barred IBM assignment to a Customer competitor, and conformed the continuing-liability sentence to "the assigning party." Fallback (mutual successor assignment on notice) is offered in the comment.
